title: P00 — Establish resource budgets and safe execution lanes
description:
## Owner
Primary coordinator, with one Terra worker for read-only inventory if useful. Complete before P01.

## Steps
1. Read initiative D16 and relevant repository instructions; capture git status without resetting existing work.
2. Measure filesystem free space, existing package/browser/model/container caches and installed dependency versions. Do not install or delete during inventory.
3. Create a task-owned execution ledger listing repository writer ownership, immutable artifact/cache paths, heavyweight-operation owner, estimated/measured peak disk and retained artifacts. Ledger is operational state; initiative remains canonical planning document.
4. Reserve at least 8 GiB free headroom and select the first serial bootstrap workspace. At current 13 GiB, schedule a maximum of two implementation agents and one heavyweight operation; block downloads whose peak cannot be bounded.
5. Record exact package/build/test commands and existing runtime locations for P01/P03/P13. Confirm clean-consumer packaging can fit; otherwise report the specific required capacity and continue lightweight inspection.

## Acceptance
Primary can dispatch P01 without conflicting writers or unbudgeted installs. A deliberately oversized operation is rejected by the scheduling policy. Existing unrelated files/caches remain intact. Add measured results as a comment; do not claim model/container/render verification from this preflight.

comments.author: home
comments.text: P00 measured 12 GiB free; caches inventoried read-only (npm 6.7 GiB, Hugging Face 13 GiB, Playwright 1.1 GiB). Existing Chromium and ffmpeg/ffprobe available. Ledger at /private/tmp/videoml-execution/ledger.md records repository ownership, baseline git state, commands and a 2.5 GiB P01 budget with no browser/model/container download. A hypothetical 5 GiB operation is rejected by the 8 GiB floor. All other repos clean; toolchain planning changes preserved. No caches deleted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Resource and ownership preflight accepted by primary; P01 may begin with exclusive heavy-operation slot and active free-space checks.
